paragraphs.text: Difficulties related to sorting household waste can have effects beyond the activity itself. paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that the instructions and collection system may not match. This can help explain why residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. Consider the following situation: a careful resident may see all bins emptied into one truck and decide not to separate waste again. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
